logp.method_description: A 10 mM compound solution in DMSO was diluted in the DPBS solution (pH = 7.41) 1:100, followed by the addition of octanol in a volume ratio 1:1, and then the mixture was stirred for 1 h at 25 °C. After that, the mixture was left to partition for 24 h. Тhe analyte concentration was measured by HPLC in the aqueous phase before(st) and after(w) equilibration with octanol. Mixtures of 20 mM solution of ammonium formate in water (component A) and acetonitrile (component B) in isocratic mode at the following ratios (A: B) were used as mobile phase: for 3b and 3d - 30: 70, for 3a - 25: 75, for 3c - 15: 85. The flow rate of the mobile phase was 0.75 ml/min. The temperature of the column thermostat was set to 30 °C. Samples were injected in volumes of 3 µl (for 3a, b, c) and 10 µl (for 3d). Detection was performed at wavelengths of 280 nm (3a), 278 nm (3b), 296 nm (3c) and 258 nm (3d). Sample injection was carried out in three repetitions. The average values of chromatographic peak areas were used to determine lipophilicity. Values of log Do/w were calculated according to the expression (5.11.1): (5.11.1) log D o / w = log ( ( A s t ν I n j w A w ν I n j s t - 1 ) V w V o ) where Vw/Vo is the volume ratio between the aqueous and the octanolic phases, ν I n j w and ν I n j s t are the injection volumes, and Aw and Ast are the chromatographic peak areas;
